title: Investigating LLM-Powered Dissenting Minority Support in Power-Imbalanced Group Decision-Making: Counterargument and Mediation as Intervention Strategies
reasoning: The paper is an empirical HCI study focusing on supporting minority voices in human group decision-making using LLMs. While it discusses the ethical implications and failures of certain design choices regarding anonymity and authorship, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning frameworks in the LLM.
